note: Provenance: no vendor API was called to produce this corpus. tests/fixtures/generation/*/naive is Django written by a language model with no auditor in the room; */repaired is the same model's second pass with the finding list in front of it. Both are replayed through the real Loop by scripts/generation_probe.py. This measures the defect density of unaudited LLM Django and the loop's mechanics. It does not measure whether any particular vendor's model produces the repaired version on demand.

billing.description: Invoices for customers, each with line items. A customer sees only their own invoices.

blog.description: Posts with comments. Drafts are visible only to their author; published posts are readable by any signed-in user.

support.description: Support tickets with threaded replies and a subject search. A reporter sees only their own tickets.
